s: Shekkol echad chayyab betalmud tora ubo b' seipim: kol ish yisrael chayyab betalmud tora, ben ani ben ashir, ben shalem begupo ben baal yissurin, vaapillu ani hamchazzer al happetachim, vaapillu baal ishsha ubanim — chayyab liqboa lo et letalmud tora bayyom uballayla, shenneemar: "vehagita bo yomam valayla". Ubeet zo tzarik sheyyilmod tora shebbiktab vetora shebbeal peh halakot pesuqot vetalmud. Velo talmud bilbad im hu techillat limmudo, lepi shebbattechilla tzarik leda harbeh min haissur vehammuttar belo teamim ureayot, veek laasot hammitzvot hannehugot kede sheyyeda lishmor velaasot velo yecheta, qodem sheyyeda hakkol al nakon meomeq limmud hattalmud. Veet zo shebbayyom mitzva min hammubchar liqboa otah miyyad achar hattepilla, qodem sheyyelek laasaqayv. Vekol hayyotze mibbet hakkeneset lebet hammidrash veholek lilmod — zokeh umeqabbel pene hashshekina, shenneemar: "yeleku mechayil el chayil yeraeh el elohim betziyyon" (veayyen sham betillim betargum yonatan ubaggemara sop masseket moed qatan dap k"t a"a ubemidrash rabba parashat shemot sop pereq b' ubirushalmi sop pereq d' dishbiit). Uqebiut haet tzarik sheyyihyeh qebua utequa beinyan shello yaabirennu ap im hu sabur leharviach harbeh. Umikkol maqom qodem sheyyelek lebet hammidrash — yakol leekol pat shacharit im hu ragil. Vetob sheyyargil bo, ki p"g mine cholaim keminyan "machala" teluyim bammara, vekullam pat bammelach veqiton shel mayim shacharit mebattaltam. Umitzva lehanhig atzmo behanhaga toba lishmor beriuto, kede sheyyihyeh bari vechazaq laabodat boreo. Veal ken eno rashshay lesaggep atzmo ella im ken yesh bo tzorek laaboda, kegon shettibo noteh lihyot shatup betaavat akila ushetiyya o shear taavot, vei epshar lo likpot tibo ella im ken yatteh atzmo leqatzeh acharon velinhog beatzmo biprishut legamre meoto dabar shettibo kosep, umanhig bazeh zeman rab ad sheyyeda benapsho sheap im yinhag atzmo bezeh hadderek hamemutztza lo yattennu tibo midderek hayshara. Vezehu kelal lekol hammiddot shebbaadam, chutz min haggaava vehakkaas shebbahem en rauy lelek bemidda benonit, ella lehitracheq miggobah halleb vehakkaas ad qatzeh haacharon. Ukemo sheameru chakamim: "meod meod heve shepal ruach" bepereq d' deabot mishna d', yeuyyan sham beperush hara"b ubeperush hammishnayot leharamba"m sheheerik bazeh veken beinyan hakkaas, ukemo sheyyitbaer leqamman siman qn"v s"g:

Im tzarik laasot dabar nachutz miyyad achar hattepilla verotzeh lilvot et haqqabua lo uleporah achar kak bayyom o ballayla (kemo sheyyitbaer besiman rl"ch saip b' mehashsha"s deerubin pereq haddar dap s"h a"a) — ap al pi ken tob sheyyilmod apillu halaka achat o pasuq echad miyyad achar hattepilla. Veap mi sheeno yodea lilmod — yelek lebet hammidrash usekar halika beyado, o yiqba lo maqom veyilmod meat bezeh sheyyodea, veyaknis yirat shamayim belibbo, vipashpesh bemaasayv, ulay yimtza bahem ezeh tzad abera veyiprosh mimmenna:
